tools.name: search_code
tools.description:
Discover Python implementation by meaning when its file or
        symbol name is unknown. Returns ranked snippets, relative paths,
        inclusive line ranges, retrieval distances and overlapping
        symbol_ids. For a known function/class name, use find_symbols.
        Follow graph relationships only for unresolved relationship
        questions. Use targeted text search for exact assignments or
        attributes.

query.description: Natural-language behavior or implementation to find in Python source and tests.
query.title: Query

tools.name: find_symbols
tools.description:
Locate a known function, method or class by exact name. Returns
        symbol_ids, kinds, paths and definition ranges. Identical names
        can produce distinct matches; select the intended path and kind
        before a graph query. Use search_code when the name is unknown.
        Set include_code=true to obtain source during lookup. Each
        code_excerpt has its own inclusive line range and truncation
        flag; definition ranges still cover the whole symbol. Reuse
        sufficient excerpts and inspect more source only for a gap.
        Assignments and attributes are not indexed symbols. After an
        empty match, switch to discovery rather than guessing variants.
        A class prefix may contain mostly documentation. Use start_line
        for a known relevant region, or prefer a relevant method. With
        an offset, truncated also indicates omitted preceding lines.

name.description: Exact simple or qualified name, such as add_url_rule or App.add_url_rule; no fuzzy matching.
name.title: Name

path.description: Optional exact repository-relative file path to disambiguate matches, e.g. src/flask/sansio/app.py.
path.title: Path

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

include_code.description: Include indexed source excerpts for implementation questions, to avoid a separate source read. Use a small limit or path to narrow matches.
include_code.title: Include Code

max_lines.description: Maximum source lines per match (1..100), used only with include_code. Classes are bounded too.
max_lines.title: Max Lines

start_line.description: Optional absolute one-based file line within each matched definition. Requires include_code=true. Skip a class prefix or retrieve a later source region; narrow by name/path first. Defaults to definition start.
start_line.title: Start Line

tools.name: get_callers
tools.description:
Investigate which indexed functions directly call a selected
        function or method. Returns caller code, definition locations
        and call sites; multiple sites can repeat a caller. These are
        partial static call edges. Other references or runtime callers
        can be absent.
        Missing edges do not prove that no callers exist. Requires a
        function ID.

symbol_id.description: Exact symbol_id returned by find_symbols or search_code. Select the intended path and kind; do not construct an ID.
symbol_id.title: Symbol Id

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_callees
tools.description:
Trace direct calls made by a selected function or method.
        Returns statically resolved callee code, definition locations
        and call sites; multiple sites can repeat a callee. External and
        unresolved dynamic calls may be absent. Requires a function ID.
        Use native source reads to investigate gaps in the graph.

symbol_id.description: Exact symbol_id returned by find_symbols or search_code. Select the intended path and kind; do not construct an ID.
symbol_id.title: Symbol Id

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_inheritance
tools.description:
Inspect a selected class's direct parents and subclasses.
        Returns relation labels, symbol_ids and definition locations.
        Requires a class ID. Follow returned IDs for further hops when
        needed. This partial static graph does not resolve inherited
        methods or compute Python's method resolution order (MRO).

symbol_id.description: Exact symbol_id returned by find_symbols or search_code. Select the intended path and kind; do not construct an ID.
symbol_id.title: Symbol Id

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: get_imports
tools.description:
Inspect resolved repository-local import bindings, aliases and
        import-site locations. Re-exports point to the ultimate defining
        file resolved by Jedi, not every intermediate package. Includes
        conditional and function-local imports, without proving runtime
        execution. External, unresolved, ambiguous and wildcard imports
        are omitted and counted. Dynamic import calls are not tracked.
        Multiple bindings/sites can return the same neighboring file.

direction.description: imports: dependencies of this file; importers: files that import from this file. One hop only.
direction.title: Direction

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: list_symbols
tools.description:
Get a compact file outline, including classes, methods, imports
        and assignments, without fetching class docstrings. Returns
        names, Jedi kinds, lexical parents and positions. Constructor
        assignments remain under the constructor scope; inherited or
        dynamically added members are not enumerated. Locations are not
        graph symbol IDs. Use find_symbols for indexed code.

parent.description: Optional exact file-local qualified parent scope, e.g. Flask or Flask.__init__. Null includes all scopes.
parent.title: Parent

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: resolve_definition
tools.description:
Follow a name at a source position to local definitions,
        including import aliases and assignments. Returns all resolved
        candidates with locations, not graph IDs. Multiple matches may
        be ambiguous.
        External targets are omitted and counted in excluded_results.
        This is static resolution, not a guarantee of runtime dispatch.

column.description: Zero-based Unicode character column, not bytes.
column.title: Column

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: find_references
tools.description:
Find repository-local uses of the symbol at a source position.
        References are broader than CALLS: imports, reads, writes and
        passing a callback may be included. Returns distinct locations,
        not caller bodies or graph IDs. Jedi can stop searching early;
        results are partial; truncated only reports the output limit.

column.description: Zero-based Unicode character column, not bytes.
column.title: Column

include_declaration.description: Include resolved definition locations as well as uses. Import bindings and writes can be references.
include_declaration.title: Include Declaration

limit.description: Maximum returned rows (1..100). Start with 3..5 and increase only when more evidence is needed.
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: index_status
tools.description:
Inspect the indexed repository, build, embedding model, counts
        and source freshness. Use for setup or stale-index diagnosis;
        retrieval tools already check freshness on every call. This does
        not verify backend connectivity or rebuild the index.
